title: SubjectCreateRequestV2
description:
Actor-scoped v2 create request.

`payload` is backend-defined so dynamic subject kinds retain their
schema-driven fields while the authentication envelope stays typed.

kind.description:
Kind for the canonical `subject/v2/create` form. A kind-prefixed
method may omit this and derive it from the method.

Actor.description:
An opaque, transport-asserted caller identity.

Constructed by the transport after it authenticates the caller, relayed
verbatim by the kernel, and consumed only by plugins for data scoping. See
the [crate-level docs](crate) for the full contract.

claims.description:
Transport-asserted claims (e.g. `["admin"]`). Advisory only: the kernel
never branches on these. A plugin MAY consult them for its own
authorization decisions. Omitted from the wire when empty.

tenant_id.description:
Optional tenant / organization partition the user belongs to. Plugins
use it for multi-tenant data isolation. Omitted from the wire when
absent.

user_id.description:
Stable identifier for the authenticated user. Opaque to the kernel;
plugins use it to scope owned rows to a user.

SubjectRequestContext.description:
Authenticated request context asserted by the application transport.

The actor is required on every v2 subject call. Correlation and
idempotency values are opaque transport identifiers: the kernel relays
them and the owning backend decides how to record or enforce them.

actor.description:
Authenticated caller. Claims remain advisory; ownership is the stable
`(user_id, tenant_id)` pair.

correlation_id.description: Optional correlation identifier spanning related requests.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key for a mutation.

request_id.description: Optional request identifier for tracing one transport request.
